mapper.select: SELECT * FROM USERS WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_PAYMENT_HISTORY ( user_idx, payment_type, payment_method, order_name, source_type, source_id, original_amount, discount_rate, discount_amount, final_amount, used_cash, used_mileage, earned_mileage, payment_status, paid_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userIdx}, #{paymentType}, #{paymentMethod}, #{orderName}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{originalAmount}, #{discountRate}, #{discountAmount}, #{finalAmount}, #{usedCash}, #{usedMileage}, #{earnedMileage}, #{paymentStatus}, COALESCE(#{paidAt}, NOW()), COALESCE(#{createdAt}, NOW()) )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM USER_PAYMENT_HISTORY WHERE toss_order_id = #{tossOrderId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM USER_PAYMENT_HISTORY WHERE toss_order_id = #{tossOrderId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_PAYMENT_HISTORY SET payment_method = #{paymentMethod}, order_name = #{orderName}, earned_mileage = #{earnedMileage}, payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, toss_payment_key = #{tossPaymentKey}, toss_status = #{tossStatus}, toss_approved_at = #{tossApprovedAt}, paid_at = NOW() WHERE payment_idx = #{paymentIdx} AND payment_status = 'READY'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_WALLET_HISTORY ( user_idx, asset_type, change_type, amount, balance_after, related_payment_idx, detail_message, actor_user_idx, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userIdx}, #{assetType}, #{changeType}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{relatedPaymentIdx}, #{detailMessage}, #{actorUserIdx}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM USER_PAYMENT_HISTORY WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} AND payment_type = 'CHARGE' AND payment_status != 'READY' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 12
SELECT * FROM USER_WALLET_HISTORY WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT member_grade_idx, policy_name, member_grade, min_monthly_payment, discount_rate, sort_order, is_active, description, priority FROM MEMBER_GRADE_POLICY WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, priority ASC, member_grade_idx ASC

SELECT member_grade_idx, policy_name, member_grade, min_monthly_payment, discount_rate, sort_order, is_active, description, priority FROM MEMBER_GRADE_POLICY WHERE is_active = 1 AND member_grade = #{memberGrade} ORDER BY priority ASC, sort_order ASC, member_grade_idx ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(final_amount), 0) FROM USER_PAYMENT_HISTORY WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} AND payment_status = 'COMPLETED' AND paid_at >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') AND paid_at < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(final_amount), 0) FROM USER_PAYMENT_HISTORY WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} AND payment_status = 'COMPLETED' AND paid_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_GRADE_HISTORY ( user_idx, base_year_month, prev_grade, new_grade, monthly_paid_amount, applied_discount_rate, calculated_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userIdx}, #{baseYearMonth}, #{prevGrade}, #{newGrade}, #{monthlyPaidAmount}, #{appliedDiscountRate}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE prev_grade = #{prevGrade}, new_grade = #{newGrade}, monthly_paid_amount = #{monthlyPaidAmount}, applied_discount_rate = #{appliedDiscountRate}, calculated_at = NOW()
